title: The joint GFF and cluster limit of critical Ashkin–Teller currents
exact_target: For each fixed $J>0$ and $U\leq J$ on $sinh(2J)=\exp (-2U)$, do the Ashkin–Teller current height, wired and free cluster collections, and distinguished boundary component converge jointly on every admissible Jordan-domain lattice approximation to the source-normalized GFF, its associated continuum cluster collections, and its specified symmetric two-valued set? Use $H^s_loc$ for every $s<-1$, cluster matching, and Hausdorff convergence for the distinguished component.
